records.name: Killiney toilets on Vico Road to Vico Beach
records.description_rewritten: An outdoor/public toilet lead along Vico Road toward the Vico/Whiterock bathing area south of Dublin. A county public-toilet inventory confirms a facility at Whiterock's entrance from Vico Road, but the directory's older claim of 10:00–18:00 daily does not match variable seasonal council opening times.
records.place_identity: Whiterock beach access toilet off Vico Road, Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown, near Killiney/Dalkey; likely identity, verify exact building.
records.access_notes: 2026 council data lists seasonal times for Whiterock public toilets: winter openings roughly 07:30–09:00 and closing 16:30–17:30; longer in spring/summer, actual times variable.

records.access_notes: South Dublin County Council: 10:00–17:00 Nov–Jan, seasonal later closings in warmer months, parking closure may precede park close.

No recent dated visits were found.
